item.title: 10 Facts about Miracles That Will Build Your Faith

item.title: Dear Future Self, God Sees You
item.description: There is no magic cream or boyfriend that can take the place of what the Holy Spirit instills in our confidence and countenance. God sees you, He hears your prayers, and He is in love with you more and more as each laugh line deepens or rejection comes.

item.title: Why Winter Is the Season God Calls Us to Rest
item.description: This winter, embrace nature's cue to rest and rejuvenate instead of chasing the typical "new year, new me" pressure. Discover how aligning with the slower, introspective rhythm of the season can lead to a more grounded and fulfilling year ahead, preparing you for true growth in the spring.

item.title: A Prayer to Forgive Others as Christ Forgives Me - Your Daily Prayer - January 30
item.description: Forgiveness isn’t easy, but it’s everything. This prayer helps you lay down the grudge and pick up the freedom Jesus died to give you.
